corrections.proposed: R-6 flat-roofed cab (CL-160 flattop) on a short steel tower; L-4 was the cab added in 1933
corrections.why: The L-4 cab dates to 1933. The cab on the site now came from Barklow Mountain in 1974 and is described as a flat-roofed or flattop steel cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1920 falls in the 1920s, when the site was a crow's nest. The L-4 cab came in 1933 and the cab there now was first erected on Barklow Mountain in 1955.
The register and the Forest Service call the site Lake of the Woods Lookout. The record uses firelookout.com's Lake O' Woods name.

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-or-lake-of-the-woods (Lake of the Woods Lookout, NHLR US 494, coordinates about 50 m apart, same Barklow cab moved in 1974). A merge is a human decision; both stories were written separately. Unresolved: last staffed 1996 (Forest Service) vs 1998 (firelookout.com); tower height 8 ft (Forest Service), 10 ft (register), 12 ft (Recreation.gov listing per the other record, not read here); elevation 3,419 ft (Forest Service, firelookout.com) vs 3,359 ft (register), record uses 1042.1 m. Location: firelookout.com says 21 miles southeast of Port Orford; the Forest Service says 21 miles northeast of Gold Beach. The story reports both positions with their sources. Record photos are firelookout.com images credited to Steve Paynter with no licence stated; not re-checked.
